# ArtaDNS

> ArtaDNS is a smart DNS benchmarking and switching utility for Microsoft Windows, developed by Arta Pardaz.
> نرم‌افزار آرتا دی‌ان‌اس ابزاری هوشمند برای سنجش پینگ، انتخاب و تنظیم بهترین سرور DNS در سیستم‌عامل ویندوز است.

ArtaDNS tests real-time latency and stability of various DNS servers directly on the user's internet connection, recommending and applying the optimal DNS server with a single click to reduce ping, improve stability, and enhance gaming and web browsing experiences.

## Key Features
- **Real-Time Benchmarking**: Measures ping and response quality for multiple public and optimized DNS providers.
- **One-Click Activation**: Changes Windows network adapter DNS automatically without needing manual configuration.
- **Cache Flushing & Reset**: Easily restore default network settings (DHCP) or flush DNS cache when needed.
- **Optimized for Gaming & Browsing**: Helps reduce packet jitter and connection lag for gamers and everyday browsing.
- **Lightweight & Clean UI**: Native, modern interface tailored for Windows 10 and 11.
